questions.q: Where is LTV Manufacturing Corporation's US parent headquartered, and where is its Canadian subsidiary?
questions.explain: The US parent is headquartered in Savannah, Georgia; the Canadian subsidiary, LTV Manufacturing Canada ULC, operates out of Windsor, Ontario.

questions.q: Who is LTV's Chief Financial Officer and executive sponsor for this engagement?
questions.explain: Elena Marsh is the CFO who commissions this implementation and later calls with the January 31 crisis.

questions.q: Which company is identified as LTV's preferred supplier for bearings and mechanical MRO parts?
questions.explain: Meridian Bearing Supply Co. is LTV's preferred supplier for bearings and mechanical MRO parts.

questions.q: Which three cost centers exist in both the US and Canadian entities?
questions.explain: Both entities mirror the same cost center structure: Assembly, Fabrication, and Corporate Overhead.

questions.q: What is the fifth of Elena Marsh's five requirements, and why does this lesson flag it specifically?
options: Build a new customer-facing website — it's out of scope for this course
Hire additional AP staff — it has nothing to do with the chapters ahead
Close the first month-end period cleanly — this is the requirement that goes wrong
Migrate to a different ERP system entirely
questions.explain: Requirement 5, a clean first month-end close, is explicitly flagged as the one that goes wrong and drives Chapter 3's crisis.
